title: PluginProcessor wiring and CMakeLists for TightCut and ChugStabilizer
description:
Wire TightCut and ChugStabilizer into PluginProcessor between input conditioning and parametric Stage A, and register phase-D sources in CMakeLists.txt. This task is the sole owner of PluginProcessor.* and CMakeLists.txt for phase D.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp processBlock/prepareToPlay structure from prior phases
- Source/DSP/TightCut.h and Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.h public APIs from d.1/d.2
- Source/ParameterIDs.h tightCut_* and chug_* parameter IDs
- CMakeLists.txt target_sources patterns from phases B/C
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md signal flow (§ intro / §6 placement): input conditioning → Tight Cut → Chug Stabilizer → parametric Stage A

Implement wiring in Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp:
1. Own TightCut and ChugStabilizer members; prepare/reset in prepareToPlay/releaseResources; no heap in processBlock.
2. processBlock order after input gain/conditioning and before parametric Stage A / main EQ chain: optional Tight Cut (honor pre/post placement if exposure exists — default pre-EQ as spec flow), then Chug Stabilizer, then existing Stage A path.
3. Push APVTS parameters each block (or smooth) into module setters using ParameterIDs for enable, frequencies, slopes/Q, punch, listen, routing, chug threshold/ballistics/Preserve Pick, etc. Disabled modules must be true bypass (bit-transparent or equivalent neutral path).
4. Respect global bypass: modules skipped when global bypass engaged consistent with existing processor behavior.
5. Do not redesign bus layout, StateManager, or editor; only DSP member integration and parameter read.
6. CMakeLists.txt: add Source/DSP/TightCut.cpp, Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.cpp, tests/TightCutTests.cpp, and tests/ChugStabilizerTests.cpp to the correct plugin/DSP and ShredEQUnitTests source lists using existing style. No unrelated target refactors.

Do NOT implement unit test bodies (d.4 owns tests) or change TightCut/ChugStabilizer algorithms beyond include/member use.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp own TightCut and ChugStabilizer instances prepared in prepareToPlay
processBlock runs Tight Cut then Chug Stabilizer after input conditioning and before parametric Stage A when enabled
APVTS tightCut_* and chug_* parameters are applied to the corresponding DSP setters
Disabled modules and global bypass do not force permanent filtering when modules are off
CMakeLists.txt lists Source/DSP/TightCut.cpp, Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.cpp, tests/TightCutTests.cpp, and tests/ChugStabilizerTests.cpp on the correct targets
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify tests/TightCutTests.cpp or tests/ChugStabilizerTests.cpp bodies (d.4 owns content)
broad CMake restructure or rename plugin targets

allowed: embed TightCut and ChugStabilizer by value on the processor
parameter snapshot helper local to processBlock
append phase-D sources to existing CMake lists only
